title: hierarchical nonlinear Mirror-MoE
hypothesis: For four related nonlinear experts in two role groups, a hierarchical group→expert router plus one shared FFN and four Givens views recovers untied hierarchical MoE quality at lower bytes and beats simple tied FiLM/residual controls; flat and low-rank routers test whether hierarchy adds value.
scope_delta: Adds a two-level group/expert token-choice router on the balanced synthetic role family used for MA006/007; all models dispatch exactly one expert role per token.
mirror_coordinate: four role-specific four-angle Givens input/output views
logical_multiplicity: four expert roles addressed through two groups and two children/group
controls: full untied flat MoE with rank-2 router
tied hierarchical expert plus per-role hidden FiLM
tied hierarchical expert plus per-role rank-2 output residual
tied hierarchical expert plus Mirror views

task.group_rule: roles 0/1 form group 0; roles 2/3 form group 1
task.structure_audit: group accuracy, role accuracy and per-role MSE

teacher.aligned: one frozen nonlinear FFN conjugated by per-role Givens views
teacher.routing_targets: known balanced role IDs and group IDs from data generator

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE across seven methods and both teacher modes

fresh.access_condition: At selected LR, aligned Mirror MSE <=1.25x untied hierarchical MSE and payload <=0.65x hierarchical payload; otherwise FAIL and keep fresh sealed.

routing.hierarchical: A two-way group router selects a group; only its two-way child router selects a role. Training loss is group CE plus selected-group child CE.
routing.token_choice: Exactly one role per input; no no-route state.

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save CPU state dict and deterministic compact JSON config

gates.development_open_fresh: Aligned Mirror MSE <=1.25x full hierarchical MoE and payload <=0.65x; otherwise FAIL/fresh sealed.
gates.fresh_useful_sharing: All three aligned fresh worlds: Mirror MSE <=1.10x full hierarchical MoE, role accuracy within 1 pp, payload <=0.65x full hierarchical.
gates.mirror_specific: All three worlds: Mirror MSE at least 10% lower than hard tying, FiLM, and rank-2 residual at no more than 10% greater bytes or active MACs.
gates.fail: Development gate misses; or fresh useful gate misses in at least two worlds; or a simple control matches within 10% MSE at equal/lower bytes/compute in at least two worlds.
gates.promising: Fresh useful gate passes >=2/3, or 3/3 with a declared simple-control/storage/runtime limitation.

boundaries: synthetic balanced roles and known hierarchy
fixed updates are not capacity evidence
no language or large-scale routing claim
